purpose: Base class for ragdolls, meant to be used with binders. This class exports a [Binder]. While a humanoid is bound with this class, it is ragdolled. Initialize this whole system through [RagdollService].
description: Base class for ragdolls, meant to be used with binders. This class exports a [Binder]. While a humanoid is bound with this class, it is ragdolled. Initialize this whole system through [RagdollService].

Shared/Classes/BindableRagdollHumanoidOn.description: Ragdolls the humanoid on fall. This is the base class. Public entry points include `BindableRagdollHumanoidOnFall.new`, `BindableRagdollHumanoidOnFall.ObserveIsFalling`.

Shared/Classes/RagdollableBase.luau.description: Ragdollable Base provides the class/model implementation used by the Ragdoll package. Public entry points include `RagdollableBase.new`, `RagdollableBase.Ragdoll`, `RagdollableBase.Unragdoll`, `RagdollableBase.ObserveIsRagdolled`, `RagdollableBase.IsRagdolled`.

Shared/Interfaces/RagdollableInterface.l.description: Ragdollable Interface provides the class/model implementation used by the Ragdoll package.

Shared/RagdollServiceConstants.luau.description: Ragdoll Service Constants provides the class/model implementation used by the Ragdoll package.

Shared/Rigging/RagdollAdditionalAttachme.description: Ragdoll Additional Attachment Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Ragdoll package. Public entry points include `RagdollAdditionalAttachmentUtils.getAdditionalAttachmentData`, `RagdollAdditionalAttachmentUtils.ensureAdditionalAttachments`.

Shared/Rigging/RagdollBallSocketUtils.lu.description: Instead of modifying this file, consider setting attributes on each motor on humanoid join. Public entry points include `RagdollBallSocketUtils.getRigData`, `RagdollBallSocketUtils.ensureBallSockets`.

Shared/Rigging/RagdollCollisionUtils.lua.description: Ragdoll Collision Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Ragdoll package. Public entry points include `RagdollCollisionUtils.getCollisionData`, `RagdollCollisionUtils.preventCollisionAmongOthers`, `RagdollCollisionUtils.ensureNoCollides`.

Shared/Rigging/RagdollMotorData.luau.description: Ragdoll Motor Data provides the class/model implementation used by the Ragdoll package.

Shared/Rigging/RagdollMotorLimitData.lua.description: Holds baseline constants for the Ragdoll Do not modify this file. Instead, do this to apply new reference values.

Shared/Rigging/RagdollMotorUtils.luau.description: Ragdoll Motor Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Ragdoll package. Public entry points include `RagdollMotorUtils.getFirstRootJointData`, `RagdollMotorUtils.getMotorData`, `RagdollMotorUtils.initMotorAttributes`, `RagdollMotorUtils.setupAnimatedMotor`, `RagdollMotorUtils.setupRagdollRootPartMotor`, `setupWeld`, `RagdollMotorUtils.setupRagdollMotor`, `RagdollMotorUtils.suppressJustRootPart`.

Shared/Rigging/RxRagdollUtils.luau.description: Utility methods to assist with rigging the ragdoll in real-time. Public entry points include `RxRagdollUtils.observeRigType`, `RxRagdollUtils.observeCharacterBrio`, `RxRagdollUtils.suppressRootPartCollision`, `RxRagdollUtils.enforceHeadCollision`, `RxRagdollUtils.enforceHumanoidStateMachineOff`, `RxRagdollUtils.enforceLimbCollisions`, `RxRagdollUtils.runLocal`, `RxRagdollUtils.enforceHumanoidState`.
